answer: To forge a second identity, an attacker must acquire and attest new physical hardware and lock a fresh onyx stake, making each sybil node cost real capital and silicon. Agents must stake an onyx token bond plus prove unique hardware via a signed falcon-512 keypair bound to their device enclave. Duplicate enclave fingerprints are slashed automatically, so multiplying identities becomes economically irrational. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
